prior_outcome_exposure: Designed after viewing every original transfer-v1 result. At 120 seconds, learned frozen-core mean future-day R2 was -1.5907455120304481 versus scratch -3.108406902511501; their difference was +1.5176613904810508, positive in 8/9 people. Every person's mean R2 was negative in both arms. The original comparison confounds source-learned weights with freezing regularization. This control was not preregistered with the original experiment.
scope: Post-hoc mechanistic control in this small, nonrepresentative offline cohort. Negative absolute accuracy remains visible.
